tasks.title: Global Navigation & Header Polish
tasks.description: Finalize desktop/mobile nav behaviors and visual consistency across all key pages.
tasks.details: Polish dropdown interactions, sticky header transitions, active state clarity, mobile drawer spacing, and CTA alignment. Confirm no overlap/clipping at 320px/375px/768px/1280px widths.

subtasks.title: Desktop dropdown usability
subtasks.description: Fix hover/focus timing and panel positioning.
subtasks.details: Ensure generator and free-coloring dropdowns open reliably without accidental close and preserve keyboard access.

subtasks.title: Mobile menu hierarchy
subtasks.description: Improve item grouping and CTA placement.
subtasks.details: Make the mobile menu scannable with clear grouping for Home/Create/Generators/Free pages and keep primary CTA visible.

tasks.title: Create Flow UX Finish
tasks.description: Refine /create interaction details for clear generation flow and trust signals.
tasks.details: Improve button states, loading skeletons, status copy, validation hints, and result card transitions. Ensure unauth/local dev states are explicit and no dead-end UI states remain.

subtasks.title: Generation status messaging
subtasks.description: Make states explicit from submit to result.
subtasks.details: Standardize pending/success/failure copy and keep result panel stable to prevent layout jumps.

subtasks.title: Form validation polish
subtasks.description: Improve inline validation and helper text.
subtasks.details: Clarify prompt requirements, supported formats, and moderation-related user guidance.

tasks.title: Free Category Page Polish
tasks.details: Tighten section rhythm, max text width, card spacing, sidebar stickiness, FAQ disclosure polish, and quick-facts readability. Confirm hero image fallback rendering is clean.

subtasks.title: Readability spacing audit
subtasks.details: Verify heading margins, paragraph rhythm, and card padding on mobile and desktop breakpoints.

subtasks.title: Sidebar behavior
subtasks.details: Fix edge cases where sidebar overlaps footer or misbehaves on shorter screens.

tasks.title: Generic Programmatic Entry Polish
tasks.description: Finish layout and content hierarchy on dynamic programmatic entry pages.
tasks.details: Polish hero-media balance, section headings, CTA placement, FAQ disclosure style, and sidebar utility blocks. Ensure long copy remains readable and consistently segmented.

subtasks.title: Hero-media composition
subtasks.description: Balance text and image in dynamic entries.
subtasks.details: Ensure media block scales consistently and does not dominate or collapse content on narrow viewports.

subtasks.title: FAQ disclosure polish
subtasks.details: Keep FAQ affordances obvious and accessible with consistent open/closed visual states.

tasks.title: Image & Asset Consistency Audit
tasks.description: Eliminate remaining visual rough edges caused by missing or inconsistent assets.
tasks.details: Audit programmatic images, card thumbnails, alt text, and fallback placeholders. Fix stretched/cropped anomalies and ensure consistent aspect-ratio behavior across cards and heroes.

tasks.title: Landing Page Visual Consistency Sweep
tasks.description: Polish homepage section-to-section consistency for launch quality.
tasks.details: Normalize spacing scale, typography rhythm, card shadows, button hierarchy, and section separators. Ensure visual language stays blue-first and cohesive from hero to footer.

tasks.title: Accessibility Hardening
tasks.description: Make core user journeys keyboard-accessible and screen-reader friendly.
tasks.details: Audit focus order, visible focus states, aria labels, link/button semantics, heading order, and color contrast. Fix all blocking accessibility issues in nav, create, and programmatic pages.

tasks.title: SEO Metadata & Structured Data Hardening
tasks.description: Close remaining SEO implementation gaps for launch.
tasks.details: Validate canonical tags, title/description quality, Open Graph/Twitter metadata, sitemap inclusion rules, robots consistency, and JSON-LD for key page types where appropriate.

tasks.title: Performance Pass
tasks.description: Optimize front-end rendering performance for mobile-first experience.
tasks.details: Reduce unnecessary payload, verify lazy loading, optimize image delivery behavior, and smooth above-the-fold render path. Keep visual fidelity while improving responsiveness.

tasks.title: Error, Empty, and Edge-State Coverage
tasks.description: Close UI gaps for uncommon but realistic user states.
tasks.details: Ensure robust handling for missing images, empty related lists, failed generation responses, no-results states, and malformed route data. Provide user-safe fallbacks and helpful copy.

tasks.title: Cross-Device QA & Bug Bash
tasks.description: Run a final multi-page QA sweep and resolve last-mile UI defects.
tasks.details: Execute desktop/mobile checks across home, create, free categories, generators, pricing, and key programmatic routes. Track and resolve clipping, spacing, interaction, and copy regressions.

subtasks.title: Desktop QA matrix
subtasks.description: Run and log desktop checks on primary routes.
subtasks.details: Capture and fix interaction, spacing, and visual regressions in Chromium-based desktop testing.

subtasks.title: Mobile QA matrix
subtasks.description: Run and log mobile checks on primary routes.
subtasks.details: Validate layout integrity at 375px and 390px widths and patch clipping/overflow issues.

tasks.title: Release Readiness & Go-Live Runbook
tasks.description: Prepare launch checklist and post-launch monitoring routine.
tasks.details: Define pre-launch checks, rollback notes, smoke-test commands, and day-1 monitoring steps. Document owner actions for fast incident response after release.

subtasks.title: Go-live checklist
subtasks.details: Document must-pass checks for routes, generation flow, SEO surfaces, and monitoring setup.

subtasks.title: Post-launch watch
subtasks.details: Track errors, generation failures, and UI regressions with clear response steps.
